# EmergencyAlert 2026 — Project Overview

This document exists because neither future Sei-chan nor future Sora should be
trusted to remember why the system was built. :)

## Origin

The original idea was ordinary and personal:

> おかあさん、そろそろ雨降ってくるよ。洗濯物しまったほうがいいよ。

The heat/WBGT feature came from the same place: give useful information early
enough that a parent can tell a child before school:

> 今日は昼から暑くなるんだってさ、気をつけなー。

EmergencyAlert is therefore not primarily a weather-information broadcaster.
Its job is to make a small piece of the near future useful early enough for
someone to act or say something to a person they care about.

## Constitution

暮らしを、少し先回りする。  
必要な人に、必要な情報を、必要な時に。  
必要でなければ、静かに見守る。

Functional tagline:

> あなたの場所の、これからを見張る。

## Meteorological boundary

EmergencyAlert does not independently forecast weather.

Official/authorized forecasts, observations and disaster information are the
source of truth. EmergencyAlert connects that information to a person's place,
time and life, decides whether it is relevant enough to surface, and explains
it clearly.

AI must not invent, interpolate or improve meteorological phenomena, timing,
rainfall values or danger levels.

## Missing-data rule

UNKNOWN_PIXEL != NO_RAIN.  
FETCH_ERROR != NO_RAIN.  
NO_DATA != SAFE.

Never turn "we do not know" into "you are safe."

## 2023 archaeology

The old application used the JMA high-resolution precipitation nowcast at the
user's geographic point. It converted latitude/longitude to a map tile and
pixel, read that pixel and mapped the JMA legend colors to precipitation
intensity bands.

Recovered historical bands:

- #F2F2FF -> <1 mm/h
- #A0D2FF -> 1-5
- #218CFF -> 5-10
- #0041FF -> 10-20
- #FAF500 -> 20-30
- #FF9900 -> 30-50
- #FF2800 -> 50-80
- #B40068 -> >=80

The user's recollection is that the colors were measured from JMA's on-screen
legend with a color inspection tool. Current investigation has found direct
JMA page assets whose RGB values corroborate several historical values. At
least one current asset differs from the old table, so 2026 must re-verify the
complete current palette before enabling it.

Rule:

> 思想は継承する。実装は検証する。

## 2026 rain product

First product: 「アメくる？2026」

Initial chain:

current location
-> public JMA high-resolution nowcast data
-> tile/pixel
-> verified interpretation
-> useful life-language message
-> later: watch place / Push

Lifestyle notification threshold under consideration:

- <1 mm/h: no Push
- 1-5 mm/h: generally no Push
- >=5 mm/h within about 30 minutes: notification candidate
- stronger rain: stronger wording

This is a product-action threshold, not a meteorological danger threshold.

For rain ending, do not infer "やみそう" from one dry frame. Current design
requires three consecutive valid NO_RAIN frames (15 minutes) with no unknown
gap before an ending claim.

## Cost constraint

Current development assumes zero fixed weather-data subscription cost.

The paid JMBSC GRIB2 feed is a future provider option only. Do not make it a
Phase 1 dependency. Reconsider it when the project has sufficient revenue or
funding.

## Current implementation / checkpoint (2026-09-20)

「アメくる？2026」の Phase 1 本線は、現在地から気象庁データを取り、
安全に解釈して簡潔な生活言葉で表示するところまで接続済み。

Implemented:

- Next.js + TypeScript scaffold
- browser geolocation -> server API -> JMA public-image provider
- Web Mercator tile/pixel path and tests
- RainInterpretationEngine states:
  `INSUFFICIENT_DATA / DRY / RAIN_AHEAD / ACTIONABLE_RAIN / RAINING / EASING / ENDING`
- claim-specific publication gate: unknown data after a supported near-term claim
  does not erase that claim, while unknown data required for the claim blocks it
- semantic event v1 separated from presentation
- casual 「アメくる？」 message formatter and visible UI
- checked-at time, location accuracy and JMA source display
- explicit uncertainty card when a claim is withheld
- stale UI results are cleared before re-check/location failure
- provider integration tests and end-to-end interpretation -> publication ->
  semantic event -> message pipeline tests
- daily fail-safe palette watcher scaffold; it detects change but never promotes
  a new RGB mapping automatically

### Rain interpretation safety now locked by tests

The engine currently fails closed for:

- malformed JMA `baseTime` / `validTime`
- stale observation (>15 minutes old)
- implausibly future observation (>5 minutes ahead)
- a forecast series whose targets are all already in the past
- empty forecast coverage (zero frames can never become DRY)
- incomplete/unknown evidence needed for a user-facing claim
- easing claims that would have to skip an unknown frame
- impossible forecast metadata where `baseTime > validTime`

The 15-minute observation tolerance is an operational freshness guard, not a
meteorological threshold.

Do not copy the forecast `baseTime <= validTime` rule onto observation frames
without provider-specific evidence. Observation and forecast metadata are
different products even when field names look similar.

> 同じ名前の項目でも、同じ意味とは決めつけない。

### Current user-facing behavior

The main UI intentionally stays simple:

- 「この先、雨なし」
- 「このあと雨くるよ」
- 「もうすぐ雨くるよ」
- 「いま雨だよ」
- 「弱くなりそう」
- 「もうすぐやみそう」

When the evidence is insufficient it instead says, in effect:

> いまは、はっきり言えないよ。雨が降らないって意味じゃないよ。

The implementation underneath may be strict; the surface should remain
glanceable and everyday.

### Current blocker

**2026-09-23 correction:** Direct browser DOM/resource inspection now links
the hrpns layer to its own precipitation legend. Seven RGB mappings are verified
against original current PNGs (including zoom 10). The remaining 20–30 mm/h
legend uses #FFF500, while PNGs contain #FAF500; the former #FAF500 registration
has been withdrawn and both yellows remain UNKNOWN_PIXEL. #00AAFF/#FFAA00
circle assets belong to AMeDAS ten-minute rainfall, not hrpns intensity.
#FF9900 is confirmed by current hrpns evidence. See
[PNG_PALETTE_EVIDENCE.md](PNG_PALETTE_EVIDENCE.md) for the source chain, originals,
hashes, exact band table and unresolved conflict. The older archaeology and
checkpoint notes must not override this correction.

The largest remaining production blocker is the current JMA PNG precipitation
palette. The current 2026 page has verified mappings for only part of the
legend. Unknown opaque RGB values remain `UNKNOWN_PIXEL`; old 2023 mappings
must not be resurrected by guesswork.

The palette watcher is intentionally fail-safe:

> 変更は自動で見つける。意味は勝手に決めない。

It is scaffolding only; finishing the main 「アメくる？」 flow takes priority
over building a clever automatic palette-promotion system.

## Immediate work from this checkpoint

1. Keep the Phase 1 rain path stable and CI-green.
2. Tighten any remaining user-facing wording that can sound more absolute than
   the official evidence (for example, prefer “雨の予報なし” over an absolute
   “雨なし” where appropriate).
3. Expose source-valid time separately from app check time when useful, so a
   fresh UI check cannot hide old source data.
4. Finish evidence-backed verification of the remaining current JMA PNG legend
   RGB mappings; never guess them.
5. Re-check the transparent-pixel => NO_RAIN assumption against current evidence
   before calling the public-image path production-ready.
6. Once the verified rain path is solid, add watch-place/change detection and
   only then Push behavior.

## Must not break

- Do not independently forecast weather.
- Do not silently convert unknown/missing data to dry.
- Do not resurrect old RGB values without current verification.
- Do not add paid weather-data subscriptions during the current phase.
- Do not make the internals complicated for the user just because they are
  complicated underneath.

## Recovery phrases

If the project becomes abstract or bloated:

> ソラ、洗濯物どこいった？

And the engineering rule:

> 未来のソラを信用するなｗ

That is why this file exists.


## 2023 design intent recovered from operation history

The animated rain-cloud GIF was not decoration. Its purpose was to make the
coming change visually understandable: not merely “heavy rain will arrive
around XX:XX”, but “this rain area is moving toward you like this, so act now.”

The 2023 implementation automated a browser, captured successive JMA nowcast
frames, assembled them into an animated GIF, and posted it to Twitter/X.
Twitter could transcode the uploaded animated GIF to MP4 for timeline delivery;
that does not mean EmergencyAlert itself generated MP4.

This is an important product principle for 2026:

> 情報を増やすのではなく、行動につながる実感を増やす。

When useful, EmergencyAlert should help the user understand the time progression
of an officially published phenomenon, while never creating or extrapolating
meteorological movement on its own.


## Output boundary — facts first, expression later

EmergencyAlert's reusable output must stop at structured facts and
interpretation. Product-specific wording is a separate presentation layer.

Canonical flow:

> Official source → EmergencyAlert interpretation → structured event → presentation/personality layer

The structured event should carry the facts needed by downstream consumers,
for example state, relevant times, intensity class, source, checked-at time,
location and location accuracy, plus data/interpretation status.

EmergencyAlert may provide its own simple everyday-language presentation, but
that wording is not the canonical output and must not be required by downstream
integrations.

For Misaki or any future consumer:

- the consumer may change tone, phrasing and personality;
- it may use its own relationship/context rules to decide how to say the fact;
- it must not change the underlying meteorological interpretation;
- it must not invent rain, timing, intensity or danger that EmergencyAlert did
  not establish from the official source.

In short:

> EmergencyAlert = 目。各サービス = 伝え方。

This boundary is a project-wide overview item because it keeps the weather
truth reusable while allowing Misaki, Push, LINE, voice or future products to
express the same event in their own way.


### Consumer simplicity is part of the EmergencyAlert contract

Separation must not mean pushing meteorological complexity into each consumer.
EmergencyAlert is responsible for turning its interpretation into a
consumer-ready semantic event.

A downstream service should not need to understand JMA tile colors, rainfall
thresholds, consecutive-frame rules, missing-data handling, or the logic that
decides whether an event is actionable.

A semantic event may therefore include fields such as:

- event type (for example, rain approaching / raining / easing / ending);
- urgency class;
- relevant timing;
- normalized intensity;
- suggested action (for example, bring laundry inside);
- source, checked-at time and data status.

The exact schema will evolve, but the responsibility boundary is fixed:

> 判断はEmergencyAlertに寄せる。表現は利用側に渡す。
> ただし、利用側に気象ロジックを再実装させない。

Misaki and other consumers should mainly decide how to express an already
grounded event in their own voice and context. They must not be forced to
reconstruct EmergencyAlert's weather logic in order to use it.

Future integration APIs/SDKs should optimize for this goal: receiving and using
an EmergencyAlert event should be simple even when the implementation behind
that event is complex.


### Keep each consumer's experience distinct

Sharing the same EmergencyAlert event must not make every consumer feel like the
same notification UI.

**アメくる？** is a glanceable utility. Its job is to answer the immediate
question with the shortest useful wording. Do not turn it into a conversational
character merely because the event layer can support richer expression.

**Misaki** is a conversational relationship experience. EmergencyAlert events
should enter naturally through conversation and context, as something Misaki
noticed and cared to mention. Do not turn Misaki into a weather notification
bot or simply paste アメくる？ copy into chat.

Therefore:

> アメくる？は簡潔に。美咲は会話の中に。

The shared event carries the grounded fact and actionable meaning; each
consumer owns its experience. Reuse the truth, not the presentation.


### Current trust metadata checkpoint (2026-09-23)

The rain API now keeps the time EmergencyAlert checked the data separate from
the valid time of the JMA observation used for the claim:

- `checkedAt`: when EmergencyAlert performed the interpretation;
- `sourceValidAt`: the observation `validTime` supplied by the JMA source.

The user-facing アメくる？ card may show both values, but must not turn a
malformed source timestamp into a plausible-looking time. If the source time
cannot be validated, omit that detail rather than guessing.

Likewise, a DRY result is presented as **「雨の予報なし」**, not the stronger
**「雨なし」**. EmergencyAlert reports what the official data supports; it does
not convert a forecast into certainty.

> 確認した時刻と、元データの時刻は別物。
> 予報がないことと、絶対に降らないことも別物。


### Transparent hrpns pixels fail closed until coverage semantics are proven

As of 2026-09-23, a fully transparent public hrpns PNG pixel is **not** treated
as `NO_RAIN`. It is classified as `UNKNOWN_PIXEL` because transparency proves
only that the overlay did not paint precipitation at that pixel; it does not by
itself prove that the coordinate/time was inside valid meteorological coverage.

This intentionally reduces useful DRY claims while the evidence gap remains.
The restriction may be relaxed only after first-party encoding evidence or a
reproducible authoritative coverage comparison establishes the public PNG
alpha/coverage semantics.

> 分からないものを「雨なし」にしない。


## First production-device milestone and next product phase (2026-09-23)

The first iPhone production test completed the real path from browser geolocation
to JMA retrieval, conservative interpretation and user-facing display. The test
also confirmed that withheld interpretation is presented separately from a data
fetch failure, with checked time, location accuracy and JMA source time visible.

This closes the initial "can the real phone ask about this place now?" milestone.
Do not keep polishing the one-shot screen as a substitute for the product's
actual purpose.

The next product phase is **watching a place over time and noticing a meaningful
change**. Design it around the existing semantic event boundary:

- a watch target is a location the user has intentionally chosen;
- repeated checks must preserve uncertainty rather than treating UNKNOWN as dry;
- notification eligibility comes from a grounded semantic transition/event, not
  from raw PNG color changes;
- deduplicate the same episode so a 5-minute source cadence does not become
  repeated nagging;
- lifestyle notifications remain quiet when there is nothing useful to say;
- Push is a delivery layer after change detection, not the weather decision
  engine itself.

Phase order: **watch target -> repeated evaluation -> semantic change detection
-> deduplication/cooldown -> Push delivery**. Persistence and scheduling should
be added only as required by that path; do not introduce accounts or a large DB
before the first watch flow needs them.

> 見張るのは天気ではなく、「今ならひと言かける意味がある変化」。


## Handoff checkpoint — 2026-09-24

This section is the current operational handoff. Read it before continuing work.

### Production / verified on real devices

- Production: `emergencyalert-gilt.vercel.app`.
- PWA foundation is deployed: manifest, service worker registration and EmergencyAlert icon.
- Android real-device test confirmed EmergencyAlert can be installed to the home screen as a Chrome-origin PWA.
- iPhone real-device weather flow is working.
- Watch-place persistence works through Supabase anonymous auth + RLS.
- A saved watch target remains until the user deletes it.
- Each target has independent `enabled` state: OFF pauses monitoring without deleting the registration.
- Delete action is deployed and was verified end-to-end on iPhone: confirmation -> DB deletion -> card disappears.
- GPS/current-location registration works.
- Facility/station search through Nominatim works.
- Japanese street-number address search now uses `@geolonia/normalize-japanese-addresses`; `江東区塩浜2-9-8` was resolved and registered successfully on a real device.
- Important bug already fixed: the address detector was accidentally `/\\\\d/` instead of `/\\d/`.
- Public Nominatim is now used as a single explicit request for facility/station search; do not restore rapid retry loops.
- The 5-minute server watcher is proven to fire automatically. `watch-rain-every-5-minutes` showed repeated successful cron runs and `watch_states.last_checked_at` updates.
- UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; it is not converted to dry/no-rain.

### Push — current starting point

Push delivery is the current main line of work.

A Supabase table `public.push_subscriptions` has already been created with:
- `owner_id`, `endpoint`, `p256dh`, `auth`, optional `user_agent`;
- unique `(owner_id, endpoint)`;
- RLS enabled;
- authenticated users can select/insert/update/delete only their own subscriptions.

The PWA does **not** yet have the complete notification-permission/subscription UI and the server watcher does **not** yet send Web Push. Continue from here.

Required flow:
site/PWA -> user explicitly enables notifications -> browser Push subscription -> save subscription -> watcher finds grounded actionable semantic change -> send Push -> only after successful delivery record notification delivery state.

Do not set `last_notified_at` merely because a notification *would* be eligible. The existing watch worker previously had simplified eligibility bookkeeping; before real Push is enabled, make `last_notified_at` mean successful delivery.

iPhone Web Push should be tested from the home-screen installed PWA. Android PWA installation has already been verified on a real device.

### Watch-target UI decision waiting for implementation

The owner requested a clearer ON/OFF control:
- `見張る：ON` should have a **light yellow-green / lime** active appearance.
- OFF should be visually subdued/n

+# アメふる（EmergencyAlert / サキクル）× 美咲 気象・防災連携 — 共同設計契約案
+最終更新: 2026-10-16 / 状態: **構想・設計合意（Draft）**。API実装済み・本番連携済みではない。
+
+> **未来のアメふるのソラ、美咲のソラへ:** これは双方のユーザーが明示した横断設計方針。別々に同じ公式気象情報を取得・解析する仕組みを作り込まない。まずこの仕様を読んで最新main・作業PR・総覧と照合し、実装済み／未実装を分けて進める。最終的なAPI仕様は双方のレビュー後に固定する。
+
+## 1. 不変の責務分担
+
+- **アメふる（提供側）:** 気象庁等の正式な公式情報の取得、地域・対象地点判定、雨・強雨・警報・災害の事実・予報区分の判定、データ欠損／鮮度／確度、エピソード／重複可能性の識別。公式データにない予測・補間・安全断定をしない。単独サービスとして成立させる。
+- **美咲（利用側）:** ユーザーが許可した対象地点・キャラクターの設定地域を選ぶ。アメふるの機械可読な判定を根拠に、会話への関連性・通常通知の要否・相手との関係性に応じた言葉を決める。人格・記憶・恋人段階をアメふるへ渡さない。
+- **安全境界:** 災害の深刻度、公式警報・避難指示、発表対象地域、重要通知の安全基準は決定的ロジックで扱い、Geminiが捏造・格下げ・抑止できないようにする。実際の緊急通知経路は個別の安全設計とレビューが必要。
+- **共通化の範囲:** データの正本化・解釈をアメふるへ集約。美咲の人格／関係性の会話化とユーザーごとの通知頻度は美咲固有。アメふる自身の生活通知アルゴリズムを美咲へ無条件に適用しない。
+
+## 2. 連携順序
+
+1. **Phase A（最初）:** 美咲のサーバーから認証付きでアメふるの読み取り専用APIへ問い合わせる Pull方式。まず降雨の現在観測・短時間予測・UNKNOWN・有効期限だけを対象にする。認証・キャッシュ・レート制限・遅延／障害時フォールバックを準備する。
+2. **Phase B:** 地域イベントの種類を拡張（強雨、猛暑／WBGT、公式気象警報、地震、台風、避難情報）。**アメふる側の公式情報処理と実装済み判定が確認できる項目だけ**公開する。種類の列挙は実装宣言ではない。
+3. **Phase C:** 通知用イベント配信（Webhook/QueueなどのPush型）を別契約で検討。署名・リプレイ防止・順序の逆転・重複配送・再試行・受信確認・購読地点・通知抑制・安全例外を先に設計。今すぐ実装しない。
+
+## 3. データ契約の候補（例示・確定スキーマではない）
+
+```json
+{
+  "schemaVersion": "weather-context.v0-proposal",
+  "eventId": "example-rain-001",
+  "kind": "RAIN_START_EXPECTED",
+  "status": "forecast",
+  "location": { "areaCode": "EXAMPLE", "label": "東京都江東区", "spatialResolution": "point-or-area" },
+  "issuedAt": "2026-10-16T08:40:00+09:00",
+  "observedAt": null,
+  "validFrom": "2026-10-16T09:00:00+09:00",
+  "validUntil": "2026-10-16T09:30:00+09:00",
+  "receivedAt": "2026-10-16T08:45:00+09:00",
+  "source": { "provider": "JMA", "product": "official-forecast", "reference": null },
+  "quality": { "state": "VALID", "reason": null },
+  "payload": { "intensityMmH": 8, "rainStartMinutes": 20 }
+}
+```
+
+**すべて架空例。実際のJMA値・現在の天気・実装されたAPIレスポンスではない。**
+
+最低条件:
+- `schemaVersion`: 後方互換・非互換変更を検知。未知バージョンはfail-closed。
+- `eventId`: 同一事象の重複抑制に使う。ただし訂正・予報更新と同一イベントを混同せず、必要ならrevision/episode IDを別定義。
+- `kind`: 事象型を表す。例 `RAIN_START_EXPECTED`, `RAIN_CONFIRMED`, `RAIN_ENDING_EXPECTED`, `HEAVY_RAIN_FORECAST`, `OFFICIAL_WARNING`, `EARTHQUAKE_OBSERVED`。正式列挙は別途承認。
+- `status`: `forecast` / `observation` / `official_announcement` を明確に分ける。予報値を観測事実として語らない。
+- `location`: 緯度経度・都道府県名だけでなく判定解像度／対象区域／地域コード、必要に応じて空間的な曖昧さを表す。対象地点の雨と自治体全域の警報は意味が違う。
+- `issuedAt` / `observedAt` / `validFrom` / `validUntil` / `receivedAt`: 発表、観測、有効期間、取り込みの時刻は混同しない。タイムゾーン明示。
+- `source`: 公式プロダクト・出典を追跡可能にする。URLなどは確定したものだけ。

# アメふる（EmergencyAlert / サキクル）× 美咲 気象・防災連携 — 共同設計契約案
最終更新: 2026-10-16 / 状態: **構想・設計合意（Draft）**。API実装済み・本番連携済みではない。

> **未来のアメふるのソラ、美咲のソラへ:** これは双方のユーザーが明示した横断設計方針。別々に同じ公式気象情報を取得・解析する仕組みを作り込まない。まずこの仕様を読んで最新main・作業PR・総覧と照合し、実装済み／未実装を分けて進める。最終的なAPI仕様は双方のレビュー後に固定する。

## 1. 不変の責務分担

- **アメふる（提供側）:** 気象庁等の正式な公式情報の取得、地域・対象地点判定、雨・強雨・警報・災害の事実・予報区分の判定、データ欠損／鮮度／確度、エピソード／重複可能性の識別。公式データにない予測・補間・安全断定をしない。単独サービスとして成立させる。
- **美咲（利用側）:** ユーザーが許可した対象地点・キャラクターの設定地域を選ぶ。アメふるの機械可読な判定を根拠に、会話への関連性・通常通知の要否・相手との関係性に応じた言葉を決める。人格・記憶・恋人段階をアメふるへ渡さない。
- **安全境界:** 災害の深刻度、公式警報・避難指示、発表対象地域、重要通知の安全基準は決定的ロジックで扱い、Geminiが捏造・格下げ・抑止できないようにする。実際の緊急通知経路は個別の安全設計とレビューが必要。
- **共通化の範囲:** データの正本化・解釈をアメふるへ集約。美咲の人格／関係性の会話化とユーザーごとの通知頻度は美咲固有。アメふる自身の生活通知アルゴリズムを美咲へ無条件に適用しない。

## 2. 連携順序

1. **Phase A（最初）:** 美咲のサーバーから認証付きでアメふるの読み取り専用APIへ問い合わせる Pull方式。まず降雨の現在観測・短時間予測・UNKNOWN・有効期限だけを対象にする。認証・キャッシュ・レート制限・遅延／障害時フォールバックを準備する。
2. **Phase B:** 地域イベントの種類を拡張（強雨、猛暑／WBGT、公式気象警報、地震、台風、避難情報）。**アメふる側の公式情報処理と実装済み判定が確認できる項目だけ**公開する。種類の列挙は実装宣言ではない。
3. **Phase C:** 通知用イベント配信（Webhook/QueueなどのPush型）を別契約で検討。署名・リプレイ防止・順序の逆転・重複配送・再試行・受信確認・購読地点・通知抑制・安全例外を先に設計。今すぐ実装しない。

## 3. データ契約の候補（例示・確定スキーマではない）

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "weather-context.v0-proposal",
  "eventId": "example-rain-001",
  "kind": "RAIN_START_EXPECTED",
  "status": "forecast",
  "location": { "areaCode": "EXAMPLE", "label": "東京都江東区", "spatialResolution": "point-or-area" },
  "issuedAt": "2026-10-16T08:40:00+09:00",
  "observedAt": null,

  "validUntil": "2026-10-16T09:30:00+09:00",
  "receivedAt": "2026-10-16T08:45:00+09:00",
  "source": { "provider": "JMA", "product": "official-forecast", "reference": null },
  "quality": { "state": "VALID", "reason": null },
  "payload": { "intensityMmH": 8, "rainStartMinutes": 20 }
}
```

**すべて架空例。実際のJMA値・現在の天気・実装されたAPIレスポンスではない。**

- `schemaVersion`: 後方互換・非互換変更を検知。未知バージョンはfail-closed。

- `kind`: 事象型を表す。例 `RAIN_START_EXPECTED`, `RAIN_CONFIRMED`, `RAIN_ENDING_EXPECTED`, `HEAVY_RAIN_FORECAST`, `OFFICIAL_WARNING`, `EARTHQUAKE_OBSERVED`。正式列挙は別途承認。
- `status`: `forecast` / `observation` / `official_announcement` を明確に分ける。予報値を観測事実として語らない。
- `location`: 緯度経度・都道府県名だけでなく判定解像度／対象区域／地域コード、必要に応じて空間的な曖昧さを表す。対象地点の雨と自治体全域の警報は意味が違う。

- 個人識別子、恋人関係・会話内容・長期記憶・API秘密鍵をレスポンスに含めない。

## 4. 地点とプライバシー

美咲側は **(A) ユーザー登録地点、(B) 許可された現在地、(C) キャラクター設定上の生活地域** を分けて保持・選択する。必要な地点の問い合わせだけ行う。現在地の取得許可・精度・取得時刻を明示し、古い位置を現在地と断定しない。

アメふるへは提供に必要な位置・地域情報だけを渡す。ユーザーIDやキャラクターIDを渡さずに処理できる契約を優先。地点のキャッシュ、アクセスログ、保持期間と再識別リスクをレビューする。警報は地点一致だけで機械的に除外しない。

- プロアクティブ通知は、通常の気遣い頻度・quiet hours・同意・重複防止を設計。**緊急防災通知の例外は別設計**。

## 6. まだ決まっていないこと

# EmergencyAlert 2026 — Project Overview

This document exists because neither future Sei-chan nor future Sora should be
trusted to remember why the system was built. :)

## Origin

The original idea was ordinary and personal:

> おかあさん、そろそろ雨降ってくるよ。洗濯物しまったほうがいいよ。

The heat/WBGT feature came from the same place: give useful information early
enough that a parent can tell a child before school:

> 今日は昼から暑くなるんだってさ、気をつけなー。

EmergencyAlert is therefore not primarily a weather-information broadcaster.
Its job is to make a small piece of the near future useful early enough for
someone to act or say something to a person they care about.

## Constitution

暮らしを、少し先回りする。  
必要な人に、必要な情報を、必要な時に。  
必要でなければ、静かに見守る。

Functional tagline:

> あなたの場所の、これからを見張る。

## Meteorological boundary

EmergencyAlert does not independently forecast weather.

Official/authorized forecasts, observations and disaster information are the
source of truth. EmergencyAlert connects that information to a person's place,
time and life, decides whether it is relevant enough to surface, and explains
it clearly.

AI must not invent, interpolate or improve meteorological phenomena, timing,
rainfall values or danger levels.

## Missing-data rule

UNKNOWN_PIXEL != NO_RAIN.  
FETCH_ERROR != NO_RAIN.  
NO_DATA != SAFE.

Never turn "we do not know" into "you are safe."

## 2023 archaeology

The old application used the JMA high-resolution precipitation nowcast at the
user's geographic point. It converted latitude/longitude to a map tile and
pixel, read that pixel and mapped the JMA legend colors to precipitation
intensity bands.

Recovered historical bands:

- #F2F2FF -> <1 mm/h
- #A0D2FF -> 1-5
- #218CFF -> 5-10
- #0041FF -> 10-20
- #FAF500 -> 20-30
- #FF9900 -> 30-50
- #FF2800 -> 50-80
- #B40068 -> >=80

The user's recollection is that the colors were measured from JMA's on-screen
legend with a color inspection tool. Current investigation has found direct
JMA page assets whose RGB values corroborate several historical values. At
least one current asset differs from the old table, so 2026 must re-verify the
complete current palette before enabling it.

Rule:

> 思想は継承する。実装は検証する。

## 2026 rain product

First product: 「アメくる？2026」

Initial chain:

current location
-> public JMA high-resolution nowcast data
-> tile/pixel
-> verified interpretation
-> useful life-language message
-> later: watch place / Push

Lifestyle notification threshold under consideration:

- <1 mm/h: no Push
- 1-5 mm/h: generally no Push
- >=5 mm/h within about 30 minutes: notification candidate
- stronger rain: stronger wording

This is a product-action threshold, not a meteorological danger threshold.

For rain ending, do not infer "やみそう" from one dry frame. Current design
requires three consecutive valid NO_RAIN frames (15 minutes) with no unknown
gap before an ending claim.

## Cost constraint

Current development assumes zero fixed weather-data subscription cost.

The paid JMBSC GRIB2 feed is a future provider option only. Do not make it a
Phase 1 dependency. Reconsider it when the project has sufficient revenue or
funding.

## Current implementation / checkpoint (2026-09-20)

「アメくる？2026」の Phase 1 本線は、現在地から気象庁データを取り、
安全に解釈して簡潔な生活言葉で表示するところまで接続済み。

Implemented:

- Next.js + TypeScript scaffold
- browser geolocation -> server API -> JMA public-image provider
- Web Mercator tile/pixel path and tests
- RainInterpretationEngine states:
  `INSUFFICIENT_DATA / DRY / RAIN_AHEAD / ACTIONABLE_RAIN / RAINING / EASING / ENDING`
- claim-specific publication gate: unknown data after a supported near-term claim
  does not erase that claim, while unknown data required for the claim blocks it
- semantic event v1 separated from presentation
- casual 「アメくる？」 message formatter and visible UI
- checked-at time, location accuracy and JMA source display
- explicit uncertainty card when a claim is withheld
- stale UI results are cleared before re-check/location failure
- provider integration tests and end-to-end interpretation -> publication ->
  semantic event -> message pipeline tests
- daily fail-safe palette watcher scaffold; it detects change but never promotes
  a new RGB mapping automatically

### Rain interpretation safety now locked by tests

The engine currently fails closed for:

- malformed JMA `baseTime` / `validTime`
- stale observation (>15 minutes old)
- implausibly future observation (>5 minutes ahead)
- a forecast series whose targets are all already in the past
- empty forecast coverage (zero frames can never become DRY)
- incomplete/unknown evidence needed for a user-facing claim
- easing claims that would have to skip an unknown frame
- impossible forecast metadata where `baseTime > validTime`

The 15-minute observation tolerance is an operational freshness guard, not a
meteorological threshold.

Do not copy the forecast `baseTime <= validTime` rule onto observation frames
without provider-specific evidence. Observation and forecast metadata are
different products even when field names look similar.

> 同じ名前の項目でも、同じ意味とは決めつけない。

### Current user-facing behavior

The main UI intentionally stays simple:

- 「この先、雨なし」
- 「このあと雨くるよ」
- 「もうすぐ雨くるよ」
- 「いま雨だよ」
- 「弱くなりそう」
- 「もうすぐやみそう」

When the evidence is insufficient it instead says, in effect:

> いまは、はっきり言えないよ。雨が降らないって意味じゃないよ。

The implementation underneath may be strict; the surface should remain
glanceable and everyday.

### Current blocker

**2026-09-23 correction:** Direct browser DOM/resource inspection now links
the hrpns layer to its own precipitation legend. Seven RGB mappings are verified
against original current PNGs (including zoom 10). The remaining 20–30 mm/h
legend uses #FFF500, while PNGs contain #FAF500; the former #FAF500 registration
has been withdrawn and both yellows remain UNKNOWN_PIXEL. #00AAFF/#FFAA00
circle assets belong to AMeDAS ten-minute rainfall, not hrpns intensity.
#FF9900 is confirmed by current hrpns evidence. See
[PNG_PALETTE_EVIDENCE.md](PNG_PALETTE_EVIDENCE.md) for the source chain, originals,
hashes, exact band table and unresolved conflict. The older archaeology and
checkpoint notes must not override this correction.

The largest remaining production blocker is the current JMA PNG precipitation
palette. The current 2026 page has verified mappings for only part of the
legend. Unknown opaque RGB values remain `UNKNOWN_PIXEL`; old 2023 mappings
must not be resurrected by guesswork.

The palette watcher is intentionally fail-safe:

> 変更は自動で見つける。意味は勝手に決めない。

It is scaffolding only; finishing the main 「アメくる？」 flow takes priority
over building a clever automatic palette-promotion system.

## Immediate work from this checkpoint

1. Keep the Phase 1 rain path stable and CI-green.
2. Tighten any remaining user-facing wording that can sound more absolute than
   the official evidence (for example, prefer “雨の予報なし” over an absolute
   “雨なし” where appropriate).
3. Expose source-valid time separately from app check time when useful, so a
   fresh UI check cannot hide old source data.
4. Finish evidence-backed verification of the remaining current JMA PNG legend
   RGB mappings; never guess them.
5. Re-check the transparent-pixel => NO_RAIN assumption against current evidence
   before calling the public-image path production-ready.
6. Once the verified rain path is solid, add watch-place/change detection and
   only then Push behavior.

## Must not break

- Do not independently forecast weather.
- Do not silently convert unknown/missing data to dry.
- Do not resurrect old RGB values without current verification.
- Do not add paid weather-data subscriptions during the current phase.
- Do not make the internals complicated for the user just because they are
  complicated underneath.

## Recovery phrases

If the project becomes abstract or bloated:

> ソラ、洗濯物どこいった？

And the engineering rule:

> 未来のソラを信用するなｗ

That is why this file exists.


## 2023 design intent recovered from operation history

The animated rain-cloud GIF was not decoration. Its purpose was to make the
coming change visually understandable: not merely “heavy rain will arrive
around XX:XX”, but “this rain area is moving toward you like this, so act now.”

The 2023 implementation automated a browser, captured successive JMA nowcast
frames, assembled them into an animated GIF, and posted it to Twitter/X.
Twitter could transcode the uploaded animated GIF to MP4 for timeline delivery;
that does not mean EmergencyAlert itself generated MP4.

This is an important product principle for 2026:

> 情報を増やすのではなく、行動につながる実感を増やす。

When useful, EmergencyAlert should help the user understand the time progression
of an officially published phenomenon, while never creating or extrapolating
meteorological movement on its own.


## Output boundary — facts first, expression later

EmergencyAlert's reusable output must stop at structured facts and
interpretation. Product-specific wording is a separate presentation layer.

Canonical flow:

> Official source → EmergencyAlert interpretation → structured event → presentation/personality layer

The structured event should carry the facts needed by downstream consumers,
for example state, relevant times, intensity class, source, checked-at time,
location and location accuracy, plus data/interpretation status.

EmergencyAlert may provide its own simple everyday-language presentation, but
that wording is not the canonical output and must not be required by downstream
integrations.

For Misaki or any future consumer:

- the consumer may change tone, phrasing and personality;
- it may use its own relationship/context rules to decide how to say the fact;
- it must not change the underlying meteorological interpretation;
- it must not invent rain, timing, intensity or danger that EmergencyAlert did
  not establish from the official source.

In short:

> EmergencyAlert = 目。各サービス = 伝え方。

This boundary is a project-wide overview item because it keeps the weather
truth reusable while allowing Misaki, Push, LINE, voice or future products to
express the same event in their own way.


### Consumer simplicity is part of the EmergencyAlert contract

Separation must not mean pushing meteorological complexity into each consumer.
EmergencyAlert is responsible for turning its interpretation into a
consumer-ready semantic event.

A downstream service should not need to understand JMA tile colors, rainfall
thresholds, consecutive-frame rules, missing-data handling, or the logic that
decides whether an event is actionable.

A semantic event may therefore include fields such as:

- event type (for example, rain approaching / raining / easing / ending);
- urgency class;
- relevant timing;
- normalized intensity;
- suggested action (for example, bring laundry inside);
- source, checked-at time and data status.

The exact schema will evolve, but the responsibility boundary is fixed:

> 判断はEmergencyAlertに寄せる。表現は利用側に渡す。
> ただし、利用側に気象ロジックを再実装させない。

Misaki and other consumers should mainly decide how to express an already
grounded event in their own voice and context. They must not be forced to
reconstruct EmergencyAlert's weather logic in order to use it.

Future integration APIs/SDKs should optimize for this goal: receiving and using
an EmergencyAlert event should be simple even when the implementation behind
that event is complex.


### Keep each consumer's experience distinct

Sharing the same EmergencyAlert event must not make every consumer feel like the
same notification UI.

**アメくる？** is a glanceable utility. Its job is to answer the immediate
question with the shortest useful wording. Do not turn it into a conversational
character merely because the event layer can support richer expression.

**Misaki** is a conversational relationship experience. EmergencyAlert events
should enter naturally through conversation and context, as something Misaki
noticed and cared to mention. Do not turn Misaki into a weather notification
bot or simply paste アメくる？ copy into chat.

Therefore:

> アメくる？は簡潔に。美咲は会話の中に。

The shared event carries the grounded fact and actionable meaning; each
consumer owns its experience. Reuse the truth, not the presentation.


### Current trust metadata checkpoint (2026-09-23)

The rain API now keeps the time EmergencyAlert checked the data separate from
the valid time of the JMA observation used for the claim:

- `checkedAt`: when EmergencyAlert performed the interpretation;
- `sourceValidAt`: the observation `validTime` supplied by the JMA source.

The user-facing アメくる？ card may show both values, but must not turn a
malformed source timestamp into a plausible-looking time. If the source time
cannot be validated, omit that detail rather than guessing.

Likewise, a DRY result is presented as **「雨の予報なし」**, not the stronger
**「雨なし」**. EmergencyAlert reports what the official data supports; it does
not convert a forecast into certainty.

> 確認した時刻と、元データの時刻は別物。
> 予報がないことと、絶対に降らないことも別物。


### Transparent hrpns pixels fail closed until coverage semantics are proven

As of 2026-09-23, a fully transparent public hrpns PNG pixel is **not** treated
as `NO_RAIN`. It is classified as `UNKNOWN_PIXEL` because transparency proves
only that the overlay did not paint precipitation at that pixel; it does not by
itself prove that the coordinate/time was inside valid meteorological coverage.

This intentionally reduces useful DRY claims while the evidence gap remains.
The restriction may be relaxed only after first-party encoding evidence or a
reproducible authoritative coverage comparison establishes the public PNG
alpha/coverage semantics.

> 分からないものを「雨なし」にしない。


## First production-device milestone and next product phase (2026-09-23)

The first iPhone production test completed the real path from browser geolocation
to JMA retrieval, conservative interpretation and user-facing display. The test
also confirmed that withheld interpretation is presented separately from a data
fetch failure, with checked time, location accuracy and JMA source time visible.

This closes the initial "can the real phone ask about this place now?" milestone.
Do not keep polishing the one-shot screen as a substitute for the product's
actual purpose.

The next product phase is **watching a place over time and noticing a meaningful
change**. Design it around the existing semantic event boundary:

- a watch target is a location the user has intentionally chosen;
- repeated checks must preserve uncertainty rather than treating UNKNOWN as dry;
- notification eligibility comes from a grounded semantic transition/event, not
  from raw PNG color changes;
- deduplicate the same episode so a 5-minute source cadence does not become
  repeated nagging;
- lifestyle notifications remain quiet when there is nothing useful to say;
- Push is a delivery layer after change detection, not the weather decision
  engine itself.

Phase order: **watch target -> repeated evaluation -> semantic change detection
-> deduplication/cooldown -> Push delivery**. Persistence and scheduling should
be added only as required by that path; do not introduce accounts or a large DB
before the first watch flow needs them.

> 見張るのは天気ではなく、「今ならひと言かける意味がある変化」。


## Handoff checkpoint — 2026-09-24

This section is the current operational handoff. Read it before continuing work.

### Production / verified on real devices

- Production: `emergencyalert-gilt.vercel.app`.
- PWA foundation is deployed: manifest, service worker registration and EmergencyAlert icon.
- Android real-device test confirmed EmergencyAlert can be installed to the home screen as a Chrome-origin PWA.
- iPhone real-device weather flow is working.
- Watch-place persistence works through Supabase anonymous auth + RLS.
- A saved watch target remains until the user deletes it.
- Each target has independent `enabled` state: OFF pauses monitoring without deleting the registration.
- Delete action is deployed and was verified end-to-end on iPhone: confirmation -> DB deletion -> card disappears.
- GPS/current-location registration works.
- Facility/station search through Nominatim works.
- Japanese street-number address search now uses `@geolonia/normalize-japanese-addresses`; `江東区塩浜2-9-8` was resolved and registered successfully on a real device.
- Important bug already fixed: the address detector was accidentally `/\\\\d/` instead of `/\\d/`.
- Public Nominatim is now used as a single explicit request for facility/station search; do not restore rapid retry loops.
- The 5-minute server watcher is proven to fire automatically. `watch-rain-every-5-minutes` showed repeated successful cron runs and `watch_states.last_checked_at` updates.
- UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; it is not converted to dry/no-rain.

### Push — current starting point

Push delivery is the current main line of work.

A Supabase table `public.push_subscriptions` has already been created with:
- `owner_id`, `endpoint`, `p256dh`, `auth`, optional `user_agent`;
- unique `(owner_id, endpoint)`;
- RLS enabled;
- authenticated users can select/insert/update/delete only their own subscriptions.

The PWA does **not** yet have the complete notification-permission/subscription UI and the server watcher does **not** yet send Web Push. Continue from here.

Required flow:
site/PWA -> user explicitly enables notifications -> browser Push subscription -> save subscription -> watcher finds grounded actionable semantic change -> send Push -> only after successful delivery record notification delivery state.

Do not set `last_notified_at` merely because a notification *would* be eligible. The existing watch worker previously had simplified eligibility bookkeeping; before real Push is enabled, make `last_notified_at` mean successful delivery.

iPhone Web Push should be tested from the home-screen installed PWA. Android PWA installation has already been verified on a real device.

### Watch-target UI decision waiting for implementation

The owner requested a clearer ON/OFF control:
- `見張る：ON` should have a **light yellow-green / lime** active appearance.
- OFF should be visually subdued/n

pr-59.body:
## 最新チェックポイント — 2026-10-13

**この先頭セクションが旧記述より優先。** PR #59 は OPEN・未merge。Production readiness は **NO**。Production migration / cron / Vault / Storage書込 / watch-rain・Push接続 / deployは未実施。

- 最新のコード検証基準: commit `b8598105b1a5d03828355844efa838db15b35c89` の CI #782 と関連する5つのproof workflowは成功。ドキュメントのみの追記コミットは `c0ba2f5`、`49f7a8f`、`3027d41`。
- CI #784（run `38310431611`、commit `c0ba2f55485e8551c9982824b9caf75b8fb5ad06`）は、確認時点で **in progress**。npm install / audit artifact / npm test / z4全国フレーム走査は成功済み。z4→z8 descendant validationは実行中。\n- 最新PR HEAD `3027d4107d2a971bd2e090eddb1754fbb89003b8`（docs-only更新）でも CI #785 と JMA z4→z10 / National rain / N03 index / All47 ownership / N03 conversion の関連workflowが新規起動し、確認時点で **in progress**。これらの最終結論はまだ未確認。
- CI #784の監査artifact `npm-dependency-audit-report`（artifact `11774227824`）を実際に展開して確認: **Critical 2 / High 1 / Moderate 2 / Total 5**。対象は `vitest`、`tinypool`、`postcss`、`next`、`@vitest/mocker`。提示された修正候補 `vitest@5.0.4` と `next@16.4.0` はmajor updateを伴うため、まだ適用していない。旧Vitest候補 `5.0.3` はこのartifactに対して古い。
- `package-lock.json` が未追跡でCIが `npm install` を使用しているため、依存ツリーは固定されていない。次の安全な作業はlockfile導入・`npm ci`検証と、major/non-major修正の分離。 `npm audit fix --force` は実行しない。
- 実際のPreview workerが、partitioned 32 MiB loader / region ownership-gather / queue-aware dispatcher / in-flight deadline cancellationをまだ使っていないこと、throughput/scheduler gateがOPENであることは変更なし。proof-onlyの測定をProduction readinessと読み替えない。

正本と作業順: [PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md](docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md)、[AMAFURU_HANDOFF_2026-10-13.md](docs/AMAFURU_HANDOFF_2026-10-13.md)、[NATIONAL_RAIN_READINESS_PROOF.md](docs/NATIONAL_RAIN_READINESS_PROOF.md)。

---

## Current state — authoritative checkpoint

PR #59 remains an isolated nationwide heavy-rain proof. Production notification paths remain disconnected.

Latest integration checkpoint: `8f4bf24` (records branch state after Work handoff). Before that, runtime/proof head `3a6827c` completed:
- CI #507 SUCCESS
- National rain proof #211 SUCCESS
- N03 national prefecture index proof #131 SUCCESS
- All47 ownership proof #5 SUCCESS
- 38 test files / 187 tests passed, queue lifecycle and build passed

### What is now proven
- Atomic scan→queue behavior is fail-closed and idempotent.
- Exact raster footprint + N03 municipality intersection works.
- Exact original polygon-component partitioning preserves boundaries/holes.
- Encoded 32 MiB bounded cache supports eviction, single-flight and bounded retention.
- Regional locality materially outperforms mixed-national cache churn in local HTTP proofs.
- All47 geometry/ownership proof: 47 prefectures, 502 chunks, 591 queries, ordered municipality equivalence preserved.
- Deadline-tail proof cancels in-flight proof HTTP around 42 s and returns claimed jobs to queue: offered 100, claimed 2, deferred 2, unclaimed 98, failed 0.

### Important integration gap
The newest safety architecture is still **proof-only**.

The actual Preview worker route still uses:
- `processNationalRainRefinementJobs()`
- `createSupabaseN03AdministrativeAreaLoader()`

It does **not yet** use the partitioned 32 MiB loader, ownership/gather path, queue-aware dispatcher, or in-flight AbortSignal deadline handling proven in scripts.

So this PR has proved a safer architecture, but the application worker is not yet running that architecture.

### Scheduler status
The proof cron migration still contains fixed primary + drain calls with `limit=50`. Later evidence rejects fixed 50x2 scheduling as a rollout design. Keep that migration unapplied; it is historical proof scaffolding, not an accepted scheduler.

### Architecture direction
Do not adopt pure byte-balanced all47 LPT ownership as the final topology. It proves deterministic complete ownership, but it can scatter unrelated prefectures across owners and lose the regional-locality benefit already measured.

Preferred convergence:
1. preserve geographic/regional locality;
2. split heavy prefectures into exact chunks;
3. load only intersecting chunks through the encoded 32 MiB cache;
4. keep a small global invocation cap (cap2 baseline; cap4 not accepted);
5. refill from observed backlog with fairness instead of fixed calls;
6. use deadline admission + in-flight cancellation + explicit final DB-RPC reserve;
7. gather only complete owner results before publishing municipality output.

### Gate status
**Atomicity gate: CLOSED.**  
**Throughput/scheduler gate: OPEN.**  
**Production readiness: NO.**

Still required:
- integrate the proven loader/worker safety path into the actual Preview route;
- bound final DB claim/save/finish/defer RPCs inside the runtime budget;
- define/measure final region-local ownership across all47;
- validate severe-load sustained drain;
- measure authorized real Storage/DB/JMA IO and target Vercel runtime memory/headroom;
- define stale-frame handling, regional/global leases/fairness and final dispatcher cadence.

No Production migration/cron/Vault/Storage changes, watch-rain/Push connection, PR merge or intentional Production deploy have been performed.

Full handoff and rationale: `docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md` and `docs/NATIONAL_RAIN_READINESS_PROOF.md`.

### New low-zoom screening evidence
JMA low-zoom max-rank proof #1 SUCCESS on live observation frame `20260930113000`.
- 1,536 z8 tiles
- 393,216 z4 parent pixels
- 6,078 z8 pixels >=30 mm/h
- missed heavy pixels: 0
- z4 parent below max z8 descendant rank: 0
- exact max-rank matches: 393,216 / 393,216 (100%)

This strongly suggests z4 can act as a max-rank coarse screen before z8 refinement, potentially cutting nationwide detail load substantially. It is **not yet adopted as a hard invariant** because this is one live observation frame, not a published JMA guarantee. Repeat across observation + forecast frames and diverse events before using z4<30 as a safe exclusion rule.


### Candidate-only refinement result (CI #523)
Fresh live forecast cycle, 12 validtimes (+5 to +60 min):
- all six z4 coarse tiles available for all 12 frames;
- only z4 >=30 mm/h candidates were refined;
- every requested candidate descendant tile was available at z5, z6, z7, z8, z9 and **z10**;
- highest fully available candidate zoom = **10 for all 12 frames**;
- candidate footprint per frame was tiny (about 1 tile at z5-z7, 2 at z8, 4 at z9, 6-9 at z10).

This clarifies the earlier 404s: exhaustive nationwide high-zoom requests can be unavailable, while the high-zoom tiles actually needed for strong-rain candidates may still be fully available. Preferred architecture is therefore z4 nationwide screening -> candidate-only high-zoom refinement -> N03/municipality work. Keep missing selected tiles as NO_DATA/fail-closed.


### Sparse-tile hypothesis result (CI #526)
We directly tested whether completely dry high-zoom forecast tiles are omitted. They are not, at least in this live sample: across nearest/middle/farthest forecast horizons, 300/300 z10 tiles selected from fully transparent z4 child blocks returned HTTP 200, and all 300 decoded as fully transparent PNGs. Wet-class samples were also 300/300 HTTP 200. So the earlier 404s are **not explained by 'dry area => no file'**. Keep 404 as NO_DATA/unavailable and investigate coverage/product availability separately.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: emergencyalert_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d emergencyalert_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm install
      # Retain the exact dependency resolution for reproducibility review.
      # This is evidence only: do not switch to npm ci until the lockfile
      # is committed and validated on a separate PR.
      - name: Retain generated npm lockfile
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: npm-resolved-package-lock
          path: package-lock.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Capture dependency audit report
        if: always()
        run: |
          set +e
          npm audit --json > /tmp/npm-audit-report.json
          audit_status=$?
          echo "npm audit exit status: $audit_status"
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p="/tmp/npm-audit-report.json";if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.log("No npm audit JSON report was produced");process.exit(0)}const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));console.log(JSON.stringify({auditReportVersion:r.auditReportVersion,metadata:r.metadata?.vulnerabilities,packages:Object.keys(r.vulnerabilities||{}).map(name=>({name,severity:r.vulnerabilities[name].severity,isDirect:r.vulnerabilities[name].isDirect,range:r.vulnerabilities[name].range,fixAvailable:r.vulnerabilities[name].fixAvailable}))},null,2));'
          exit 0
      - name: Retain dependency audit report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: npm-dependency-audit-report
          path: /tmp/npm-audit-report.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - run: npm test
      - name: Scan all forecast frames at z4
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npx tsx scripts/national-forecast-z4-screening-proof.ts | tee /tmp/forecast-z4-screening.json
      # Live JMA is an external evidence source. Its 503/timeouts must not
      # suppress independent N03, queue fencing, and production build checks.
      # The report step below preserves the result as OPEN, never as PASS.
      - name: Validate forecast z4 screening against available z8 descendants
        id: forecast_lowzoom
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 15
        env:
          JMA_FORECAST_LOWZOOM_CONCURRENCY: 8
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npx tsx scripts/national-forecast-lowzoom-validation.ts | tee /tmp/forecast-lowzoom-validation.json
      - name: Report live forecast low-zoom proof availability
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Live forecast low-zoom proof outcome: ${{ steps.forecast_lowzoom.outcome }}"
          if [ "${{ steps.forecast_lowzoom.outcome }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::warning::Live JMA z4/z8 validation unavailable or failed; safety evidence remains OPEN, not passed."
            {
              echo "### Live JMA z4/z8 safety evidence: OPEN"
              echo "The external proof did not complete successfully. Do not infer rain absence or screening safety."
              echo "Review the failed step and any retained artifact before promotion."
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            {
              echo "### Live JMA z4/z8 proof execution: SUCCESS"
              echo "Execution succeeded; review JSON fields (including screeningContractConfirmed and completeCoverage) before treating the empirical evidence as sufficient."
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Retain live forecast low-zoom evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: live-forecast-lowzoom-evidence
          path: /tmp/forecast-lowzoom-validation.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Probe candidate refinement zoom availability across all forecast frames
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npx tsx scripts/national-forecast-refinement-zoom-proof.ts | tee /tmp/forecast-refinement-zoom.json
      - name: Probe whether JMA omits empty high-zoom forecast tiles
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          JMA_TILE_EXISTENCE_SAMPLE=100 npx tsx scripts/jma-sparse-tile-existence-proof.ts | tee /tmp/jma-sparse-tile-existence.json
      - name: Reproduce live JMA forecast 404s and capture coordinates
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          JMA_404_OUTPUT=/tmp/jma-404-url-evidence.json npx tsx scripts/jma-404-reproduction-proof.ts | tee /tmp/jma-404-reproduction.json
      - name: Retain reproduced JMA 404 URL evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jma-404-url-evidence
          path: /tmp/jma-404-url-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Track reproduced JMA 404s for 10 minutes
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          if [ -f /tmp/jma-404-url-evidence.json ]; then
            JMA_404_INPUT=/tmp/jma-404-url-evidence.json \
            JMA_404_RETRY_SCHEDULE_MS=150000,300000,450000,600000 \
            JMA_404_RETRY_SAMPLE_PER_FRAME=120 \
            npx tsx scripts/jma-404-delayed-retry-proof.ts | tee /tmp/jma-404-delayed-retry.json
          else
            echo '{"mode":"JMA_404_DELAYED_RETRY_PROOF","skipped":true,"reason":"404 evidence missing"}' | tee /tmp/jma-404-delayed-retry.json
          fi
      - name: Retain delayed JMA 404 retry evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jma-404-delayed-retry-evidence
          path: /tmp/jma-404-delayed-retry.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - run: npx tsx scripts/national-rain-budget-proof.ts
      - name: Measure read-only live national rain throughput
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          N03_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/national-rain-throughput-cache npx tsx scripts/national-rain-live-throughput-proof.ts | tee /tmp/national-rain-live-throughput.log
      - name: Measure bounded worker with real N03 and synthetic strong-rain stress
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          for scenario in dense fragmented; do
            for concurrency in 1 4; do
              N03_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/national-rain-throughput-cache npx tsx scripts/national-rain-stress-throughput-proof.ts "$scenario" "$concurrency" | tee -a /tmp/national-rain-stress-throughput.log
            done
          done
          N03_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/national-rain-throughput-cache npx tsx scripts/national-rain-stress-throughput-proof.ts hokkaido 4 | tee -a /tmp/national-rain-stress-throughput.log
      - name: Prove exact Hokkaido polygon partition design locally
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npx tsx scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts prepare-prepared /tmp/n03-partition-design /tmp/national-rain-throughput-cache/01.areas.json | tee /tmp/national-rain-partition-throughput.log
          for mode in full partitioned compare worker-1 worker-4; do
            npx tsx scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts "$mode" /tmp/n03-partition-design | tee -a /tmp/national-rain-partition-throughput.log
          done
      - name: Compare representative exact N03 partitions
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root=/tmp/n03-readiness-data
          mkdir -p "$root"
          for code in 01 42 03 47; do
            if [ -f "/tmp/national-rain-throughput-cache/$code.areas.json" ]; then
              cp "/tmp/national-rain-throughput-cache/$code.areas.json" "$root/$code.areas.json"
            else
              npx tsx scripts/prepare-n03-storage-data.ts "$root" "$code"
            fi
            npx tsx scripts/n03-representative-readiness-proof.ts prepare "$root" "$code" | tee -a /tmp/national-rain-readiness-representatives-throughput.log
            for mode in whole uncached partition compare; do
              npx tsx scripts/n03-representative-readiness-proof.ts "$mode" "$root" "$code" | tee -a /tmp/national-rain-readiness-representatives-throughput.log
            done
          done
      - name: Measure read-only HTTP sensitivity with actual worker
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for args in '01 whole nominal 4 50' '01 cached nominal 4 50' '01 cached nominal 1 50' '42 cached nominal 4 32' '03 cached nominal 4 32' '47 cached nominal 4 32' '01 cached constrained 4 32' '01,42,03,47 cached nominal 4 16'; do
            npx tsx scripts/n03-http-worker-readiness-proof.ts worker /tmp/n03-readiness-data $args | tee -a /tmp/national-rain-readiness-http-throughput.log
          done
      - name: Prove bounded cache under sustained actual worker calls
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npx tsx scripts/n03-sustained-worker-readiness-proof.ts /tmp/n03-readiness-data 12 | tee /tmp/national-rain-readiness-sustained-throughput.log
      - name: Compare separate worker invocations and scheduler replay
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for args in 'national 0 2' 'regional 0 2' 'regional 3000 2' 'regional 0 4'; do
            npx tsx scripts/n03-parallel-invocation-readiness-proof.ts /tmp/n03-readiness-data $args | tee -a /tmp/national-rain-readiness-parallel-throughput.log
          done
          npx tsx scripts/national-rain-readiness-scheduler-proof.ts /tmp/national-rain-readiness-parallel-throughput.log | tee /tmp/national-rain-readiness-scheduler-throughput.log
      - name: Verify queue-aware and deadline proof candidates
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npx tsx scripts/national-queue-aware-proof.ts | tee /tmp/national-rain-queue-aware-throughput.log
          N03_PROOF_HARD_DEADLINE=1 N03_PROOF_CONCURRENCY=2 N03_PROOF_OFFERED=100 npx tsx scripts/n03-parallel-invocation-readiness-proof.ts /tmp/n03-readiness-data regional 0 2 | tee /tmp/national-rain-deadline-throughput.log
          npx tsx scripts/national-queue-aware-proof.ts /tmp/national-rain-deadline-throughput.log | tee /tmp/national-rain-deadline-scheduler-throughput.log
          N03_PROOF_HARD_DEADLINE=1 N03_PROOF_CONCURRENCY=2 N03_PROOF_OFFERED=100 npx tsx scripts/n03-parallel-invocation-readiness-proof.ts /tmp/n03-readiness-data owned-chunks 0 2 | tee /tmp/national-rain-owned-chunks-throughput.log
          N03_PROOF_HARD_DEADLINE=1 npx tsx scripts/n03-http-worker-readiness-proof.ts worker /tmp/n03-readiness-data 03 cached constrained 2 100 | tee /tmp/national-rain-deadline-constrained-throughput.log
          N03_PROOF_HARD_DEADLINE=1 N03_PROOF_COLD_ONLY=1 npx tsx scripts/n03-http-worker-readiness-proof.ts worker /tmp/n03-readiness-data 03 cached deadlineTail 2 100 | tee /tmp/national-rain-deadline-tail-throughput.log
      - name: Retain nationwide throughput evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: national-rain-throughput-evidence
          path: /tmp/national-rain-*-throughput.log
      - name: Benchmark fixed N03 intersection
        if: always()
        run: npx tsx scripts/n03-administrative-area-benchmark.ts
      # This remote research endpoint is not a prerequisite for the core
      # national-rain safety checks. Preserve failure evidence without
      # skipping N03, queue-fencing, and production build verification.
      - name: Measure Koto census town boundary TopoJSON
        id: census_town_boundary
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npx tsx scripts/census-town-boundary-topojson-proof.ts | tee /tmp/census-town-boundary-topojson.json
      - name: Report Koto boundary proof availability
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Koto census TopoJSON proof outcome: ${{ steps.census_town_boundary.outcome }}"
          if [ "${{ steps.census_town_boundary.outcome }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::warning::External census boundary proof unavailable; this evidence remains OPEN, not passed."
          fi
      - name: Measure live N03 detail phases
        run: |
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 "https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/data/N03/N03-2026/N03-20260101_13_GML.zip" -o /tmp/n03-tokyo.zip
          rm -rf /tmp/n03-tokyo
          mkdir -p /tmp/n03-tokyo
          unzip -q /tmp/n03-tokyo.zip -d /tmp/n03-tokyo
          npx tsx scripts/n03-tokyo-live-rain-proof.ts /tmp/n03-tokyo/N03-20260101_13.geojson > /tmp/n03-live.json
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/n03-live.json","utf8"));process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(x.selectedDetailInput));' > /tmp/n03-selected-input.json
          N03_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/n03-cache npx tsx scripts/n03-selected-prefectures-proof.ts < /tmp/n03-selected-input.json | tee /tmp/n03-first.json
          N03_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/n03-cache npx tsx scripts/n03-selected-prefectures-proof.ts < /tmp/n03-selected-input.json | tee /tmp/n03-cached.json
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/n03-first.json","utf8"));const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/n03-cached.json","utf8"));if(b.cacheHits!==b.loadedPrefectures.length)throw new Error("expected all N03 prefectures from cache");if(b.preparedCacheHits!==b.loadedPrefectures.length)throw new Error("expected all prepared N03 areas from cache");if(JSON.stringify(a.affectedAreas)!==JSON.stringify(b.affectedAreas))throw new Error("cached N03 result mismatch");'
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const root="/tmp/n03-cache";const rows=fs.readdirSync(root).filter(n=>n.endsWith(".areas.json")).sort().map(name=>({prefectureCode:name.slice(0,2),bytes:fs.statSync(path.join(root,name)).size}));const totalBytes=rows.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+row.bytes,0);console.log(JSON.stringify({preparedN03Sizes:rows,totalBytes,totalMiB:Math.round(totalBytes/1048576*100)/100}));'
      - name: Verify reproducible N03 prepared-data generator
        run: |
          rm -rf /tmp/n03-prepared-check
          npx tsx scripts/prepare-n03-storage-data.ts /tmp/n03-prepared-check 13
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/n03-prepared-check/manifest.json","utf8"));if(m.dataset!=="N03-20260101")throw new Error("unexpected dataset");if(m.files.length!==1||m.files[0].code!=="13")throw new Error("unexpected prepared prefecture");if(!fs.existsSync("/tmp/n03-prepared-check/13.areas.json"))throw new Error("prepared Tokyo file missing");if(m.files[0].bytes<=0||m.files[0].areas<=0)throw new Error("prepared Tokyo file empty");if(!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(m.files[0].sha256))throw new Error("prepared Tokyo hash missing");'
      - name: Prove national rain queue lease fencing and lifecycle
        env:
          PGPASSWORD: postgres
        run: |
          psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d emergencyalert_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
          create role anon nologin;
          create role authenticated nologin;
          create role service_role nologin;
          SQL
          psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d emergencyalert_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/migrations/20260929_create_national_rain_refinement_jobs.sql
          psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d emergencyalert_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
          insert into public.national_rain_refinement_jobs
            (run_key, basetime, validtime, zoom, tile_x, tile_y, priority)
          values
            ('ci-race', '2026-09-29T10:00:00Z', '2026-09-29T10:05:00Z', 10, 400, 200, 1000);

          do $lease_fence$
          declare
            v_job_id bigint;
            token_a uuid;
            token_b uuid;
            outcome text;
            stored_owner text;
            stored_status text;
            child_count integer;
          begin
            select id, lease_token into v_job_id, token_a
            from public.claim_national_rain_refinement_jobs(1)
            where run_key = 'ci-race';
            if v_job_id is null or token_a is null then raise exception 'worker A did not receive a lease identity'; end if;

            update public.national_rain_refinement_jobs
            set claimed_at = now() - interval '6 minutes'
            where id = v_job_id;

            select lease_token into token_b
            from public.claim_national_rain_refinement_jobs(1)
            where id = v_job_id;
            if token_b is null or token_b = token_a then raise exception 'reclaim did not rotate lease identity'; end if;

            outcome := public.complete_national_rain_refinement_job(
              v_job_id, token_a,
              jsonb_build_object('job_id', v_job_id, 'run_key', 'ci-race', 'basetime', '2026-09-29T10:00:00Z',
                'validtime', '2026-09-29T10:05:00Z', 'zoom', 10, 'tile_x', 400, 'tile_y', 200,
                'strong_pixel_count', 1, 'municipalities', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('owner', 'A'))),
              jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('run_key', 'stale-child', 'basetime', '2026-09-29T10:00:00Z',
                'validtime', '2026-09-29T10:06:00Z', 'zoom', 8, 'tile_x', 1, 'tile_y', 1))
            );
            if outcome <> 'STALE_LEASE' then raise exception 'stale result completion was not rejected: %', outcome; end if;

            outcome := public.finish_nation

+# N03 polygon partition design — 2026-09-30
+
+Decision: continue with exact polygon-component chunks, starting with Hokkaido.
+This is an offline design proof, not an application loader or an approved
+Production format. Existing 47-prefecture Storage objects remain untouched.
+
+## Partition unit and correctness
+
+Split a MultiPolygon into its original Polygon components. Keep each exterior
+and every hole together; do not clip boundaries, simplify coordinates or split
+an indivisible Polygon. Pack spatially adjacent components into chunks with a
+soft 1 MiB JSON target. An index maps component bbox and original area/polygon
+ordinals to a chunk and records chunk bytes/hash. Select chunks by rain bbox,
+then use the existing exact intersection code on selected components. Bbox
+selection alone never establishes a municipality hit. Merge by original area
+ordinal, retaining original N03 order and one result per administrative code.
+
+This avoids keeping the complete prefecture geometry alive. Four named regions
+of Hokkaido would still have uneven sizes and unnecessary geometry loads; a
+municipality can also have distant islands. Original components plus an index
+preserve that identity without introducing artificial geographic boundaries.
+
+## Local evidence
+
+See `proofs/n03-hokkaido-partition-design.json`. Official N03-20260101 Hokkaido
+source was converted by the existing parser. Exact coordinate reconstruction
+passed for all 9,556 components in 194 administrative-code rows (including wards).
+Prepared JSON is 39.68 MiB; index is 1.24 MiB. There are 46 chunks totaling
+40.47 MiB. Largest chunk is 1.27 MiB: one original polygon exceeds the soft
+target. This design does **not** guarantee a 1 MiB upper bound.
+
+| Fresh-process N03-only variant | 37 queries elapsed | Process peak RSS |
+| --- | ---: | ---: |
+| Complete prepared prefecture | 1.191 s | 402.71 MiB |
+| Index + serial chunk reads, no geometry cache | 1.539 s | 152.11 MiB |
+
+All 37 complete ordered result arrays matched: stress tile 228/94, 35 zoom-8
+tile rectangles covering the prefecture bbox, and whole-prefecture coverage.
+The stress tile returned 44 administrative-code results; it read 13 chunks,
+12.16 MiB, with 229 selected components out of 2,408 decoded components.
+Packing overhead and increased request count need further optimization.
+
+These are local synthetic footprint / filesystem measurements. They exclude
+JMA PNG, worker concurrency, DB and Storage HTTP. The extra time is a tradeoff;
+the 152 MiB result is **not** the worker peak and cannot be subtracted from the
+previous approximately 1 GiB worker peak. Throughput acceptance remains open.
+
+The prototype also exercises the actual bounded worker on 50 synthetic dense
+Hokkaido jobs, using a single N03 resolver admission slot across the invocation
+and no geometry retention. Local c1: 50/50 in 11.292 s, peak 310.58 MiB;
+c4: 50/50 in 11.177 s, peak 453.43 MiB, max batch 1.076 s. Both retain 44 exact
+hits/job. This runs PNG scan, exact footprint and result serialization, but
+still excludes real HTTP/DB. It reads 650 chunks / 637,416,850 bytes per run:
+the cache-free policy is memory evidence, not an accepted IO strategy.
+
+CI #499 at `57c22e9bbf68226b6b432371f6e9307c3106ff06` passed all checks.
+Its same-run whole-loader c4 baseline was 50/50 in 11.272 s, peak 786.42 MiB;
+partition c4 was 50/50 in 14.476 s, peak 323.62 MiB (44 hits/job unchanged).
+Partition c1 was 15.390 s / 176.05 MiB. CI N03-only peaks were 336.06 vs
+153.86 MiB with all 37 ordered results matching. See
+`proofs/national-throughput-ci499.json`; do not compare isolated hardware
+samples as a universal memory bound.
+
+## Other prefectures
+
+The component format is generic across all prefectures. Prioritize by actual
+prepared bytes and measured selectivity, not land area. Read-only metadata for
+all 47 existing objects is in `proofs/n03-prepared-size-snapshot.json`.
+
+| Priority candidate | Prepared MiB |
+| --- | ---: |
+| Hokkaido | 39.7 |
+| Nagasaki | 28.4 |
+| Iwate | 27.5 |
+| Miyagi | 22.9 |
+| Kagoshima | 21.9 |
+| Okinawa | 17.7 |
+| Mie | 17.0 |

+This ranks investigation effort, not proven benefits. Geometry distribution,
+chunk selectivity and HTTP overhead decide whether partitioning helps each
+prefecture. Small datasets may remain whole. Hokkaido is the only real dataset
+with partition equivalence and memory evidence at this checkpoint.

+
+Before wiring into the proof worker, harden manifest/part schema and identity
+validation. Missing/corrupt selected chunks must fail the job, never become
+an empty result. Use immutable versioned data and source/manifest fingerprints;
+any future partition upload uses a new namespace after authorization, not an
+overwrite of the verified prepared data.

+do not create four independent full caches. Pin in-use chunks, evict unused
+chunks, and defer work when admission capacity is exhausted. Serialized bytes
+are not decoded heap bytes: measure decoded coordinate counts and RSS/headroom
+before selecting limits. Oversized polygons need explicit admission handling.
+

+prefectures, cold/warm HTTP, repeated requests, cache eviction and oversized
+parts. Check exact result equality against the whole loader, completion under
+45-second start budget/60-second route limit, backlog age and sustained drain.
+Only those measurements can set safe job and invocation limits.
+
+Region workers can distribute CPU across invocations after memory admission is
+proven. Assign each forecast/zoom-8 tile one owner; a job still intersects all
+overlapping prefectures, including neighbors. Region grouping cannot remove
+the global invocation cap, deadline or shared backlog controls.
+
+## Reproduce without Production access
+
+`scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts` supports:
+
+```sh
+npx tsx scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts prepare /tmp/n03-partition /path/to/N03-20260101_01.geojson
+# Or: prepare-prepared /tmp/n03-partition /path/to/01.areas.json

+npx tsx scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts partitioned /tmp/n03-partition
+npx tsx scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts compare /tmp/n03-partition
+npx tsx scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts worker-1 /tmp/n03-partition
+npx tsx scripts/n03-hokkaido-partition-design-proof.ts worker-4 /tmp/n03-partition
+```
+

+each variant in a separate process, asserts ordered equivalence and retains the
+measurement log. Memory/time are observations, not hardware-independent pass
+thresholds. Five unit tests cover holes, islands, ordering/deduplication,
+corruption/missing chunks and indivisible oversized polygons.

+merge and Production deployment are outside this work.

+

+chunks into eight resource bins using descending encoded bytes and deterministic
+least-loaded placement. This avoids geographical naming assumptions and keeps
+original polygon components and holes intact. Placement must be frozen and
+versioned with the data manifest, never recomputed by independently arriving
+workers. Bytes are a balancing proxy, not measured CPU/traffic/RSS weights.
+
+Each parent rain job expands to the intersecting chunks selected by the existing
+inclusive bbox index. Child key is parent identity plus chunk identity. Each
+child has exactly one owner. A cross-border rain tile must create work in every
+intersecting owner, not select one owner from the tile center. Decode one chunk
+at a time with the existing 32MiB encoded LRU. The parent is published only after
+all expected children finish. Deduplicate municipality codes and gather in
+canonical original prefecture/area order, independent of completion order.
+
+The all47 workflow checks official real polygons, every prefecture bbox tile,
+full bbox and boundary lines, with completion order reversed. Exact original
+whole-loader results are required. Holes and island components are not clipped.
+Synthetic tests also reject duplicate/missing children and ambiguous ownership.
+Atomic child claims, manifest-version queue fencing and global leases are NOT
+implemented in Production; this is a design/geometry proof, not DB readiness.
+
+## Deadline / HTTP
+
+Isolated `national-deadline-worker.ts` is not imported by application routes.
+It admits a batch only with 20s work allowance plus 3s final reserve before a
+45s deadline. Fetch/resolver signal aborts at 42s; interrupted claimed jobs are
+deferred. Remaining jobs stay unclaimed. Existing route worker is unchanged.
+Synchronous geometry cannot be preempted, and final RPCs remain local stubs:
+no hard target-runtime deadline claim is allowed. A measured 19s cold batch is
+an observation, not an upper bound. Abort/reserve tests and real-data HTTP
+nominal/constrained c2, cap2 proof must be read together with this limitation.
+Production private Storage GET credentials are unavailable in this workspace;
+no policy, key, Vault or object changes are made. HTTP data are actual N03 with
+assumed loopback bandwidth/latency; **実Storageでは未検証**. No DB/JMA latency.
+

+
+Normal cap1; pending >=64 or oldest >=60s permits a second invocation. Global
+cap2 stays the baseline. Refill immediately after completion; choose the oldest
+pending region batch to avoid starvation. The simulator retains every job,
+records outstanding queued+processing depth and oldest age, calls, peak
+concurrency, conservative summed worker peak RSS, and five-minute snapshots.
+Compare continuous cap2 with queue-aware cap2 and cap3 (comparison only; not
+accepted). CI502 cold representative profiles plus 1.5 service margin calibrate
+24 virtual cycles: normal48, 576, 1536 per five minutes; twelve consecutive1536
+bursts followed by twelve48 cycles. All invocations are conservatively cold.
+This is a virtual service replay, not sustained live real-IO capacity. It is
+intentionally capable of failing: overload must remain visible, never discarded
+or disguised by obsolete-frame deletion. Grouping chunk children introduces
+additional units; existing parent-job calibration cannot certify their capacity.

+
+Keep throughput/scheduler gate OPEN until all47 geometry evidence, runtime IO,
+atomic owner/global lease lifecycle, HTTP/DB tails, 45s deadline finalization,
+and severe demand sustained drain are established. Cap3/4 is not adopted merely
+because virtual processing improves. Target Vercel memory allocation and a
+measured safe aggregate RSS budget remain required. Production migration is
+not ready. CI/test success alone does not change this decision.

+invocations, c2 and global cap2, over the four locally available representative
+prefectures. Each resolver selects only chunks belonging to its owner; every
+other chunk is skipped before IO. These are partial child results. Counts from
+eight children MUST NOT be reported as completed parent jobs or compared with
+whole-prefecture jobs/sec. Parent fan-out, atomic gather and real DB storage are
+not part of this IO harness. Full all47 HTTP traffic and eight-owner long-run

+separate parent-job calibration; it does not certify the eight-owner system.

+
+Status: **implemented on the PR #59 proof branch; isolated PostgreSQL CI verification pending; not Production-ready**.
+Related blocker: `docs/NATIONAL_RAIN_READINESS_PROOF.md`, section “2026-10-10 Queue lease fencing audit”.

+## 2. Required ownership invariant
+
+Every successful claim creates a **new, unrepeatable claim identity**. The identity is scoped to one job attempt and is replaced on every successful reclaim. All state-changing operations must prove that their identity is still current inside the same database transaction that performs the write.
+
+Suggested representation (choose one during review):
+- random `lease_token UUID` generated by the database on each claim; or
+- monotonic per-job `claim_generation BIGINT` incremented atomically on each claim.
+
+A random token is simpler to compare; a monotonic generation is easier to audit. Either is acceptable only if it is generated/changed atomically by the claim RPC, returned to the worker, never accepted from an untrusted caller as the source of truth, and checked by every mutating RPC. Do not rely on `attempts` as a fence unless its increment, returned value and every conditional write are proven atomic and non-reusable.
